The successful candidate will work closely with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Platform Engineers, Security, and Product partners to deliver resilient, cloud native AI platforms in a highly regulated environment.

Design, build, and operate AI focused infrastructure platforms supporting model development, training, evaluation, and inference.
Engineer scalable, reliable, and secure cloud native services to support AI workloads across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments
Partner with AI Engineering and Data Science teams to improve developer experience, performance, and operational stability of AI systems
Enable production deployment of ML models and LLMs within governed enterprise environments, aligned with firmwide risk and compliance standards
Implement and maintain infrastructure as code and automation to ensure repeatable, auditable platform provisioning
Build and operate observability, monitoring, and alerting solutions for AI platforms, ensuring availability, performance, and cost transparency
Collaborate with Security and Risk partners to integrate identity, access controls, data protection, and governance into AI infrastructure
Contribute to architectural decisions and technical standards for AI platforms across Aladdin
Participate in on-call rotations and operational support as required call rotations and operational support as required for critical platforms.
Continuously evaluate emerging AI infrastructure technologies and apply them pragmatically within BlackRock’s enterprise context.

Required
Qualifications

Strong experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or systems engineering roles.
4+ hands-on expertise with AWS and/or Azure and/or GCP, including Azure ML, Azure Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, as well as cloud compute, networking, storage, and security services.
Understanding of ML platform operations and governance concepts, including model deployment strategies, lifecycle management, monitoring/observability, and Disaster Recovery
Experience supporting LLMs, generative AI platforms, or model serving infrastructure.
Experience supporting AI and machine learning workloads, with exposure to managed compute for model training and finetuning, experimentation over large datasets, and end to end MLOps pipeline flow including data ingestion, training, validation and deployment.
Proficiency with Infrastructure as code tools (e.g., Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation).
Strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, or similar).
Experience building and operating containerized and Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling based platforms.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. jobs.description:
About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

This is a hybrid role with visits to our Kraków office.

What You'll Do

Own technical decision-making for the teams you support: evaluate technology options, run POCs and benchmarks, and make evidence-based recommendations on frameworks, datastores, and infrastructure —including partition strategies, migration plans, and performance validation at SaaS scale
Shape platform-level architecture: Kubernetes (AKS) deployment topology, Kafka-based messaging, durable workflow orchestration, and multi-tenant data models
Serve as an embedded architecture partner for .NET product teams: review technical designs, code, author/critique RFCs, guide teams through scalability and cloud-readiness problems, and help converge products toward shared platform standards
Mentor engineers across teams and raise the bar on engineering standards (GitOps, golden pipelines, observability, supply-chain security)
Assess established on-premises products for scaling, performance, resiliency, code quality, technology choices, supported environments, interoperability, security, and third-party dependencies, and define a realistic migration path to SaaS that does not disrupt on-premises delivery
Partner with Product Management, Support, and Professional Services to ground architecture recommendations in real customer and field issues, and review findings with those teams before publishing
Produce architecture artifacts — C4 diagrams, RFCs, design reviews, benchmarks — and present trade-offs to engineering leadership
Design, build, and improve microservices and backend systems for the SaaS platform using related technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, JDK 21+, and .NET. Follow sound cloud-native development principles, including API-first design, resilience patterns, and comprehensive unit, integration, and performance testing.
Turn recurring solutions into shared libraries, tooling, and examples that other teams can adopt.
Use AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, and design exploration. Review generated code with the same care as any other contribution, including correctness, security, and maintainability.

Skills And Experience

10+ years in software engineering, with a track record of technical leadership
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
Hands-on expertise in Java (Spring ecosystem)
Hands-on experience with C#/.NET and sound architectural judgment, with the ability to review designs and code, provide design guidance, and help product teams address scalability and cloud-readiness challenges.
Working familiarity with Active Directory and Entra ID: domain services, LDAP, authentication protocols, and directory data models, with the appetite to go deeper
Comfortable reasoning about Windows-centric on-premises products (agents, domain controllers, customer-installed footprints) and the constraints of dual on-premises and SaaS delivery
Production Kubernetes experience: service design, Helm/GitOps deployment, jobs, autoscaling, multi-tenant SaaS operations
Comfortable with distributed-data fundamentals: partitioning, consistency trade-offs, high-volume ingestion/ETL, query performance tuning; hands-on with a relational database at scale (PostgreSQL, SQL Server or similar), plus exposure to at least one analytical or NoSQL store
Event-driven architecture experience (Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar), API-first design, and modern resilience/observability practices
Good documentation skills — comfortable producing RFCs and design docs and influencing teams you don't manage

Nice to have

Go, Azure, workflow engines (e.g. Temporal)
Experience with Spring Reactive
Exposure to identity security, such as ITDR, privileged access management, or identity governance

Our Values

At Netwrix, Our Values Guide Every Action

Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

Competitive Health Benefits
Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission.

jobs.description:
The NetSuite Engineer
plays a critical role in ensuring stable, compliant, and scalable financial operations within NetSuite. This position partners closely with Finance teams to support daily operations while actively contributing to the implementation, stabilization, and continuous optimization of the ERP system.

The role is key to building internal NetSuite expertise within PayU, reducing reliance on external vendors, and ensuring business continuity following the SAP system decommissioning.

Combining deep NetSuite expertise with hands-on ownership of financial processes and data, this position acts as a single point of accountability for system stability, automation, and reporting integrity.

Responsibilities:

Provide day-to-day operational support to Finance teams, including Accounting, Billing, Tax, Treasury, and Procurement
Ensure accuracy, reliability, and completeness of financial processes such as invoicing, revenue recognition, journal entries, and period-end postings
Configure, maintain, and optimize NetSuite financial setups in line with accounting standards, internal policies, and compliance requirements
Support month-end and year-end close processes, as well as other critical financial deadlines
Design, implement, and maintain process automations to improve efficiency and reduce manual work
Support NetSuite reporting and financial data extraction for Finance and Management needs
Maintain system documentation and ensure compliance with Internal IT General Controls (ITGC), including access management, change management, and audit support
Analyze and validate accounting impacts of system changes, new processes, and integrations
Monitor and support system integrations (e.g. REST, CSV, SOAP, ODBC), ensuring data accuracy and timely issue resolution
Collaborate with and manage external vendors supporting integrated systems
Act as the internal NetSuite subject-matter expert and oversee vendor-delivered work when required
Support the development of a finance data layer sourced from NetSuite, ensuring data consistency, traceability, and auditability
Design and maintain datasets, tables, and structures for financial reporting and analysis
Build and optimize SQL-based queries and reports for Finance, Controlling, and Management
Ensure alignment between NetSuite transactional data and downstream reporting, BI, and data warehouse solutions
Act as a gatekeeper for system and data changes impacting financial reporting, ensuring accuracy and compliance

Requirements:

Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with NetSuite, preferably in complex, international environments
Strong understanding of core finance processes, including Record-to-Report (R2R), Order-to-Cash (O2C), and Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
Proven experience supporting financial operations during ERP implementations, migrations, or major system changes (NetSuite migration experience is a strong plus)
Experience with NetSuite financial configuration (Chart of Accounts, subsidiaries, taxes, items)
Knowledge of programming/scripting languages (Python, SQL, JavaScript, HTML)
Hands-on experience with NetSuite customizations (workflows, custom fields, custom records, roles, permissions, internal controls)
Experience with SuiteScript for automation and process enhancements
Experience supporting system integrations (REST, CSV, SOAP, ODBC) and resolving integration issues
Ability to analyze and validate accounting and reporting impacts of system and process changes
Experience building and maintaining reporting datasets or databases based on NetSuite data is a plus
Advanced SQL skills for complex queries, reconciliations, and financial reporting is a plus

What we offer:

Full-time employment under a contract of employment,
Benefits: ability to develop one’s own package in MyBenefit system,
Access to an internal training platform,
Friendly work atmosphere in a young cooperation-driven team,
Work in an international organization operating in a rapidly changing industry

Our environment:

A diverse working environment within a multicultural setting,
An inclusive environment that ensures we listen to a diverse range of voices when making decisions,
A positive, get-things-done workplace,
A dynamic, constantly evolving space (change is par for the course - important you are comfortable with this),
Ability to learn cutting edge concepts and innovation in an agile start-up environment with a global scale,
A democratic work environment where you can drive your outcomes

Design end-to-end AI/ML solution architectures aligned with enterprise business, data, security, and infrastructure requirements

jobs.title: AI-First Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Nion is an IT consultancy with offices in Stockholm, Malmö, Gothenburg, Skopje, Bitola and Sofia, where 200+ IT specialists work together to deliver tailored digital solutions. Our clients operate in industries such as telecom, fintech and insurance, and we help organisations simplify complex challenges and create real business value.

We're looking for an experienced AI-First Senior Software Engineer
for our Stockholm office.

This is not a "coder" role. Our position is deliberate: the era ahead needs software engineers , not software developers . AI has hyper-accelerated the software cycle — but it cannot hold accountability. The engineer does. With AI handling most code generation, human attention becomes the scarce resource and moves upstream and downstream of the keyboard: to priorities, trade-off decisions, governance and final judgment, while agents handle execution in between.

Your job is to do what AI cannot — set direction, make the judgement calls, and keep acceleration from turning into compounding risk across functionality, security, compliance, maintainability and knowledge continuity. The Factory's goal is accelerated, secure and sustainable software delivery, and you are the person who holds that line.

What You'll Do

System design. Own the big picture — how components fit together, how data flows, how failures propagate. Modularity, standards and flexibility, not just the unit of code in front of you.
Domain modelling. Understand the client's business problem deeply enough to design the right solution, not just a working one. Widening the problem context is where the real advantage is.
Architectural patterns. Know which patterns to apply, when and why. As AI produces design artefacts faster than organisations can evaluate trade-offs, your role shifts toward decision engineering — choosing and validating, not just producing.
Process design — the core responsibility. Design the repeatable process by which software gets built, tested, deployed and maintained. In practice this means designing and orchestrating agentic coding flows, including patterns such as orchestrator–worker (an orchestrator decides sub-tasks, initiates them and synthesises results) and evaluator–optimizer (one model generates, a second evaluates and feeds back, and the loop iterates). You decide where a deterministic workflow is right versus a more autonomous agent.
Quality judgment. Know what good looks like, recognise when AI output is wrong, and have the discipline to reject it. Quality control moves from line-by-line review toward designing tests, feedback loops and validation checkpoints.
Tooling — the right tool for the job. Fluency across product-development tools, AI-acceleration (code-generation) tools, infrastructure tools and quality-control tools. The best results come when tools have full access to the specific codebase and knowledge base — and well-structured, standardised codebases yield the largest gains.
Accountability. You hold accountability — not the AI. Put bluntly: vibe coding is not software engineering.

Your profile

8+ years of hands-on software engineering, with deep fundamentals in architecture, system design, modularity and standards (non-negotiable — AI amplifies skill, it doesn't substitute for it)
An early adopter of AI-first development, with proven, in-production experience implementing AI-first software development processes — not just experimenting with tooling
Demonstrable experience designing and orchestrating agentic / AI-assisted development workflows (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer, and workflow-vs-agent decisions)
Strong critical evaluation of AI output and the discipline to reject it
Test design, feedback-loop design and validation skills over line-by-line review
Security, compliance and maintainability awareness in AI-accelerated pipelines
Infrastructure / CI-CD fluency and the ability to work across the full SDLC
Domain-modelling ability — translating a business problem into the right technical solution
Prompt and context engineering as a working skill, not a novelty
Strong collaboration and communication, with deep client and product integration
Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken

Tools you'll work with

AI-acceleration: Claude Code, agentic coding tools and LLM platforms (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI)
Languages & engineering: .NET, Java or Python at senior depth, with strong Git and code-review practice
Workflow orchestration: agent frameworks and multi-step orchestration (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer patterns)
Infrastructure: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes
Quality control: automated testing, evaluation and validation frameworks for AI-assisted output

Meritorious

Anthropic Claude certification or equivalent AI platform credentials
Experience standing up AI-first processes at team or organisation scale
LLM evaluation, guardrails and testing strategy experience
Domain experience in telecom, fintech or insurance
Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience

What this role is not

It is not a prompt-driven "code typist," and it is not someone who ships unreviewed AI output. Used incorrectly, AI tools make a codebase less reliable, and automated processes compound that risk. Your judgement, ownership and process design are the product.

We're Looking For Someone Who Is

Professional and committed to delivering solutions that meet real business needs
Accountable and self-driven — you take ownership of the big things and the small things
Communicative and a team player; resilient under the cognitive load of carrying large context (we build teams with fail-over and redundancy, because AI burn-out is real)
Flexible and open to some travel in connection with client projects

With us you get

A collaborative, flat organisation where support is a given. Your consultant manager acts as a mentor to ensure your professional development and wellbeing.
A clear career path and continuous learning through projects, mentorship and skills development.
A vibrant company culture with strong team spirit, knowledge sharing and social activities that make work fun.

Company laptop, phone and subscription

jobs.description:
emagine is looking for: Principal Data Architect – Group Information Model and Data Architecture

emagine is looking for a Principal Data Architect for our client in the financial and information services sector. The client operates across four Nordic markets and is at the start of a multi-year transformation. Data from Oracle, Db2 and mainframe environments will be consolidated into a governed operational data platform on AWS, while existing systems continue to support the business.

This is the most senior architectural role in the programme. You will own the Group information model, domain model and data architecture. The core challenge is to distinguish genuine business differences between markets from historical inconsistencies, and to build a common model that endures regardless of technology choices. The programme is deliberately small: existing staff supported by a handful of senior specialists.

Responsibilities

Define the Group information model: common business concepts, entities and relationships, and where local variation is required.
Own the domain model, including bounded contexts, context maps, shared language and service boundaries based on DDD. The model is implemented through versioned data contracts, semantic models and domain services.
Introduce anti-corruption layers between new domain contracts and legacy systems of record.
Define how the model, governance and data contracts are implemented on the operational data platform, and contribute to platform decisions.
Design the migration architecture, covering patterns, reconciliation, dependency sequencing and acceptance criteria for a gradual transition without a big-bang cutover.
Design data governance: classification, lineage, information ownership, retention, access control and country-specific regulatory requirements.
Set architecture principles, standards and review processes, and support delivery teams.

Requirements

Principal-level experience in data architecture, information architecture or enterprise architecture within a regulated business.
Experience establishing common information models across multiple markets, business lines or organisations.
Practical experience with domain-driven design (bounded contexts, context maps, domain ownership).
Experience designing and governing large-scale analytical or operational data platforms, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent.
Experience with data migration or CDC from operational systems such as Oracle, Db2 or PostgreSQL.
Experience treating schemas, data contracts and semantic models as versioned engineering artefacts.
Solid understanding of GDPR, DORA and related governance requirements.
Strong ability to build consensus across business and technology teams.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

Experience from Nordic financial services, information services or other regulated data businesses.
Domain knowledge in credit, risk, lending or decisioning.
Modernisation of mainframe, Db2 or Oracle environments.
ML/AI governance, feature stores or model lineage.
Evaluation of public-cloud, sovereign-cloud or hybrid deployment models.
Swedish

Technology landscape

AWS, Amazon S3, CDC from Oracle/Db2/PostgreSQL, SQL, Python, Java/Spring Boot, rules-engine based decisioning, and tooling for metadata, lineage and information governance.

Location

Stockholm, hybrid with remote work as required.

October/November
